ns2:section.sectionText: DESCRIPTION for Econ Data Lab: Students in the Lab will work in groups to organize and analyze a data set, develop models, solve problems, and present results. There will be at least a one-hour meeting a week, in-person, at a time to be announced, and it is expected 4 hours of work apart from meeting time. Participation and a final presentation will be part of the work. REQUIRED PREREQUISITES: Econ 203 and practical experience with R or Python. To apply please complete the following form: https://forms.illinois.edu/sec/1347205677
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Computer Science & Economics or Economics or Econometrics & Quant Econ major(s).
